description: This file defines a static class for testing configuration related to Azure Storage in Orleans Journaling tests. It includes methods to check preconditions and configure default options for tests involving Azure Blob Storage, specifically handling different authentication scenarios.

classes.name: JournalingAzureStorageTestConfiguration
classes.description: A static class providing configuration and precondition checks for Azure Storage tests related to Orleans Journaling.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks whether necessary configurations are set for running Azure Storage related tests; skips tests if conditions aren't met.

methods.name: ConfigureTestDefaults
methods.description: An extension method that configures the provided AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageOptions with default settings based on the current test configuration, particularly handling different authentication methods.
